question: The Webshare free plan (10 shared datacenter proxies, 1 GB a month, email or Google sign-up, no card) is an offer of its own, drafted as new/ip-proxy/webshare-free-plan.json by unit u01 of run 20261030-1250-verify-ip-proxy-efa4, but the integrator's duplicate matcher (same domain and provider name) maps every Webshare draft in ip-proxy onto ip-proxy/webshare-static-residential, so no discover unit can add it. Should it be added as ip-proxy/webshare-free-plan with relate variant_of ip-proxy/webshare-static-residential, or should the matcher treat a different category or tier of one vendor as a different offer?
why: The vendor states the free proxies are datacenter and 'not included in any of our paid plans', so folding them into the static ISP record credited a residential product with a datacenter allowance; the static record is now paid-only, and the free plan's own record has nowhere to land.
